raw_html: [[Limb Chopper]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Limb Chopper]]:''' This potent and feared ability allows the weapon to sever the limbs of those it strikes. On an attack roll of 20 which is confirmed as a critical hit, the weapon severs an opponent's limb from its body. Some creatures, including many [[aberration]]s and all [[ooze]]s, have no limbs. Others, such as [[golem]]s and [[undead]] creatures, are not affected by the loss of their limbs. Most other creatures, however, have their movement slowed 75% and attacks slowed by 50% when a limb is cut off.
